scope: Single arm64 macOS 27.0.1 (26A434), SIP enabled, probe launched from a harness process that has NO Accessibility and NO post-event (synthetic input) permission. Disposable fixtures only; no screenshots (screen recording not granted); no user preference, hotkey or Dock change.

pathSummary.reason: CGPreflightPostEventAccess=false for the launching process; the probe refuses to post and no event was sent. Symbolic hotkeys 79-82 are enabled (default, no custom parameters). Not a failure of the method; untestable from this host.

pathSummary.scope: Non-empty ghost-free target Space only. 6/6 attempts on clean Spaces (54: 3, 46: 3) pass signals 1-3. Signal 4 not applicable (no post-event access), so inputEvidence=false; proxy only: target fixture reported appIsActive and isKeyWindow=true, origin NO.
pathSummary.caveat: After bridged current-Space operations touched a Space (runs 5-6), the same activation did not switch (0/6 attempts pass). See ghostStateFinding.

pathSummary.reason: AXIsProcessTrusted=false for the launching process; not run.

0/5 attempts pass signals 2 and 3. SkyLight getter matched in 0.1-1 ms and fixture processes received workspace notifications (9.7-125 ms), but the origin fixture stayed on the CG on-screen list and origin occlusionVisible stayed true. In the first attempts the target fixture self-reported isOnActiveSpace=YES while the origin still showed as visible/on screen: managed-state flag changed, compositor did not.

0/3 attempts pass, but all ran after bridged operations had put Spaces into the ghost state where plain activation (B1) also fails, so the result is confounded. A clean-state CB run was not obtained: in runs 3 and 4 the C attempt left the Space contaminated before CB could run.
Hotkeys 118-126 are all unspecified (not enabled) in the existing user configuration; preferences were not modified.

overallVerdictNote: Only B1 produced a closed-loop real switch (signals 1-3 plus proxy for 4), for a non-empty, ghost-free target Space. The bridged setter fails the loop and contaminates later native switching. Keyboard paths could not be tested from this host.
ghostStateFinding: After a bridged SLSBridgedManagedDisplaySetCurrentSpaceOperation (including the restore fallback that sets the target and then the original), the touched Space stayed in a state where a fixture reporting isOnActiveSpace=NO (membership: that Space) was still listed by CGWindowList on-screen with occlusionVisible=true, for at least the remaining session and across new processes. In that state NSRunningApplication activation of an app whose only window is on that Space no longer switched Space (B1 0/6). Spaces 6, 54 and 46 were affected during this task.
spaceReorderFinding: Run 3 (target 54, non-adjacent) ended with Space order [46,7,54,6] instead of [46,7,6,54] (same IDs, same current). Consistent with the macOS default 'rearrange Spaces by most recent use' (mru-spaces key unset = default on) moving a non-adjacent target next to the current Space; not proven. Adjacent switches (targets 6 and 46) did not reorder. The original order has not been restored.
setupObservations: Control-Right/Left, AX raise and F19 input routing need a host with Accessibility/Post-Event permission (for example a signed, authorised Switchly build) and were not executed here.

The probe controller process never received NSWorkspaceActiveSpaceDidChangeNotification (controllerReceived=false in every attempt, even after finishLaunching); the fixture processes (full NSApplication run loop) did. Signal 1 is therefore satisfied by the fixture processes.

The first, superseded runs (target 6) are not stored: B1 attempt 1 already showed signals 2,3,5 passing at 460.9/318.7/298.4 ms but its bridged-only restore failed, which motivated the native-activation restore.
